gamerule.betterdeath.better_keep_invento: On death, damageable items stay on the player and the other items go to an allay waiting where the player died. The vanilla keep inventory rule takes over when it is on.
gamerule.betterdeath.experience_loss.des: Percentage of the levels lost on death. 0 keeps every level, 100 loses them all. No experience orb drops.
gamerule.betterdeath.durability_loss.des: Percentage of the maximum durability a damageable item loses on death. Unbreaking does not reduce it, and a worn out item breaks.
gamerule.betterdeath.keep_damageable_ite: Items with durability stay in the inventory. Off, they go to the allay, and still lose their durability.
gamerule.betterdeath.keep_stack_chance.d: Chance in percent that a random part of each stack stays in the inventory instead of going to the allay.
gamerule.betterdeath.allay_lifetime.desc: Ticks of game time before the allay disappears with the items it keeps. 36000 is 30 minutes.
